relations.support_notes: Because the author is referred to in bSam gtan bzang po's commentary (ID:4735), if one adopts the date 1356 for that composition, dKa' bzhi pa Shes rab seng ge must be different from rGyud smad shes rab seng ge.

comments:
The work contains a summary on the Vinayakārikā (ID:7858) - one of the three currently extant - and a topical outline.

Discussed in [N77QW83A]: 187, n. 156 and [UGZJBIWM]: 374.

In the topical outline, the author indicates that he relies on the oral teaching of "nam mkha'", probably mChims nam mkha' grags (ID:3977) ([UGZJBIWM]: 374).
